notes.title: Chapter IV
notes.content:
[b]Hi there![/b]

Finished working on Chapter (level) IV.
Game (beta) version is now 0.41. Demo was updated accordingly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/956fef7992f5d551522cc92854a83c9b3dc1dbd8.png[/img]Lady Drucilla's castle.


[h2]What's Inside?[/h2]
Without giving too much spoilers, chapter IV is about Lady Drucilla and occurs in her castle.
Having said Lady Drucilla, I would like to thank Dani Finn again for her amazing voice work, help with promoting the game and for streaming the demo play. Very much appreciated!
So, what do we got here?
[list]
[*] New castle.
[*] New guard models.
[*] New guard voices.
[*] All engine improvements mentioned in the previous Demo 0.41 update announcement
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/0048c1d884a0a77761820bbad6d19d0e68c3cb54.png[/img]


[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
Working on chapter V.
Once I'm done with chapter V, I'm planning to do another engine improvements round and release demo version 0.50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/70c7bc6d1cb1b12feb8e1ec50bb65d67cb9261c5.png[/img]


[h2]Release (Up)Date[/h2]
It appears I won't make it to finishing the game on Q2, so I postponed the release to Q3. Hoping to release somewhere around mid-summer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/42baa73bf29e0bf4b22d6d763e9160babd5aee03.png[/img]New Guards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/53a5bdf02a41ee4fb360f16908309cb2be756c20.png[/img]Lady Drucilla



[b]Cheers![/b]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.41
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/23a3cfc895e3c8182f717b31c9dfe128e090a5df.png[/img]


[b]Hi there![/b]

Level 4 is done. A news post about it will be posted very soon.

After the demo release and during the time of the Next Fest, I've received some important and precious feedback.
At that point, I've decided to work in two dimensions: Add more content and enhance the game.
I wanted to make a big enhancement break after finishing level 5.
Then, I've got the privilege of watching the lovely Dani Finn which is the voice actress of Lady Drucilla (level 4 and [b]no-spoilers[/b]...) and also a streamer, playing the demo and I understood that some key elements in the demo need to be sharpened in order for new players to enjoy it a bit more.
So I made a couple (more than a couple) of additions, fixes and tweaks and uploaded Demo version 0.41.

Before proceeding to the details, I would like to thank each and everyone who played the demo and left feedback.
Yes, I want this game to succeed, but moreover, I want people to just enjoy it so your feedback is precious to me and to potential players, so thank you! :)


[h2]So, What's Inside?[/h2]
[list]
[*] More guard voices.
[*] Two more music tracks.
[*] Added a few more sword hit/whoosh, bow pull/release sound effects.
[*] Different footstep sounds on grass and dirt.
[*] Body hit sounds for chainmail wearing characters and plate wearing character.
[*] Very few combat timing related modifications which made the combat for personally me - more fun. I hope it is not me alone. In any case, more combat and enemy AI enhancements will come in the future.
[*] Stamina drains less on strike. Now you can spam that attack button on 'Timed' mode.
[*] In addition to above, added a small chance to double strike the enemy successfully. If I see this direction picks up, I may add a third combat option "Hack and Slash" where you can fight the enemy like a hack and slash game. Tell me if this is something you prefer.
[*] Made the player sword block direction compatible with the enemy attack direction in 'Timed' mode to make it look more natural.
[*] Removed the invisible blocker in Lord Gerald's throne room. Now you can go behind Lord Gerald and... I don't know...
[*] Added an info box at the first appearance of each mode. You can see two in the demo's two modes: Exploration Mode and Horde Mode.
[*] Added useful tips.
[*] Game starts with the tutorial but you can skip it. Consider playing it if you are not familiar with the game.
[*] In level 1, you start a bit farther and not right next to the tower.
[*] Fixed the wooden sound when William gets hit by an arrow.
[*] UI display of available weapons.
[*] Tapping a weapon number again sheaths that weapon.
[*] Applied the beautiful artwork of Schwarky Art - Johanna Schmidt in the main menu.
[*] Added fall damage.
[/list]

That's it. I hope you'll like it.

[b]Enjoy![/b]

notes.title: The Journey to the Official Release
notes.content:
[b]Hi there![/b]

It has been a super busy month for the guards and for the goats so I have lots to share.


[h2]The Past[/h2]

Major milestones accomplished:
[olist]
[*] The official demo was released.
[*] GvG participated in Steam Next Fest!
[/olist]
Two important things happened thanks to the above two:
[olist]
[*] The game got more exposure.
[*] I've got some important comments about the demo which I intend to apply to the game.
[/olist]

[h2]The Present[/h2]

In parallel to the demo and the Next Fest mania, I've continued developing the game and finished level 2 and 3.
Level 3 introduces new game modes: [b]Boss Fight[/b] and [b]Run[/b].
Now working on level 4 and level 4 will add a new spirit to the game:
[list]
[*] A new castle.
[*] New guards. Models and [b]voices[/b]!
[*] A new boss.
[/list]
Reminding you that castles and bosses that are unlocked in story mode can be used in custom chapter mode.


[h2]Images from Level 2 and 3[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/9847c705320b4a2115b17c682aa6ff1691d2ea36.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/0f25f34763b7c17406f2d620b8757d07a0417e06.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/952dc94376529c5ca0de54513f5991fcacfba63a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/567a1fdab00b9a122322f586722d92ae8ad22a48.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/714696665ccf71d717357431ccf08202f06ab3d8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/c09f9e7a072ade79b7586d99a73f076cbfc65e29.png[/img]Boss Fight

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/e1eb03b48b699148dd39e4473dbe8db23f7c6d3f.png[/img]Run


[h2]The Future[/h2]

Hoping to finish level 4 soon, I'll be glad to share info about level 4 in more detail + screenshots and perhaps a promo video or two.
Then, level 5, naturally.
My original plan was to take a pause when level 5 is finished and apply some of the comments I've received for the demo. I might decide to do that sooner - when level 4 is done. Depends on my momentum.
Either way, when those comments are applied, I'll release an updated version of the demo, of course (level 1).
Then, I'll be glad to say that I'm halfway to the official release :) So exciting!


Thanks to everyone who wishlisted, commented and played the demo!

[b]Cheers![/b]

notes.title: Demo Version 0.18
notes.content:
[h2]What's inside?[/h2]


Introducing Dark Mode.
Gives the game darker lighting, where some areas can be pretty dark.
Dark Mode can be toggled in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/7ff8ce16c07177743efb08e46ad861c853da5917.png[/img]Dark Mode off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/36f09c0ef66bf03d976fe2d23bf89ad785ebacaa.png[/img]Dark Mode on.


So what is darkness without a torch to light your way?
Added a torch to the player. Press the T button to pop it up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/6832525894c0330536cc6865744f90860fee7da1.png[/img]

Also revised some first person animations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/312f54c3923343d2a18f202e5605eca9d6cf80f5.png[/img]


[h2]Smaller stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Aside from (and because of) the Dark Mode, enhanced the game lighting and some materials to look slightly better. This means that even if you don't want to play in Dark Mode, graphics will still look improved a bit.
[*] Reduced guards field of view just a bit to give the player more chance to perform a sneak attack.
[*] Slightly more stuff to loot.
[*] Added level borders to the training level. (thanks Salvo)
[*] Updated the splash screen.
[*] Bugfix: Guards with shields where slide-walking when on patrol.
[*] Bugfix: Arrows were attaching to level borders.
[/list]

[b]Enjoy![/b]

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.content:
[b]Hi there![/b]


[h2]Demo Released[/h2]
The demo consists of chapter I out of the ten chapters of the full game.

[h3]Story[/h3]
Lord Gerald has summoned you (William) to his castle to ask you to perform a special job - Lord Sinclair has captured his daughter Lady Stefania and wants a large ransom in return.
Get in, rescue the princess, get out. What can go wrong?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/5ee824c4563f29e77a41036a337ee154a72ab2ec.png[/img]

[h3]Technical[/h3]
[list]
[*] First public version of the demo - version 0.16.
[*] Fully tested and polished.
[*] As written above - consists of the first chapter of the story.
[*] Doesn't contain the custom chapter game mode. That will be available in the full game.
[*] Play, enjoy and please leave feedback in the Community Hub.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/a6895002be707ef5af524fa7f4163f986d24b3fd.png[/img]

[h2]So, What Now?[/h2]
Now, I will be working in parallel on:
[olist]
[*] Demo related comments and bug reports.
[*] The next chapters of the game. Already working on chapter II.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/50455c4c86810e88edb889c97e939fad05398f40.png[/img]

[b]Enjoy the demo!
Cheers![/b]

notes.title: The Way To The Demo - Halfway There
notes.content:
[b]Hi there![/b]

[h2]Hello Kate[/h2]
When I sent the prototype to friends, the major feedback I received was "I didn't understand the controls". That opened up three possible ways to tackle this issue and I went for all three:
[list]
[*] Polish the directional combat.
[*] Add an option for a simpler timed based combat.
[*] Add a tutorial (training) level.
[/list]
Kate was a placeholder character in the prototype (she's not in the story), so I've decided to turn her into the player's trainer.
Wrote tutorial lines, searched for a voice actress and found the brilliant Erin Kress to voice her.
So now you'll have a training level where Kate will teach you the basics of directional combat, timed combat and later on - how to use a bow (not implemented yet).
In addition to those tutorials, you'll have an option to have a friendly duel with her.
You can find a detailed video of her here in the store page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/0dc0dc3ddcabcb1cfb5e1bcfbc19b9a75abb4da2.png[/img]Training with Kate

[h2]Current status of the demo[/h2]

[h3]What's done[/h3]
Everything you see in the prototype plus:
[olist]
[*] Designed the interior and exterior structure of the castle that will appear in the demo.
[*] Found voice actors for the 5 characters that will appear in the demo.
[*] Received 80% of the demo voice lines.
[*] Polished the directional combat mechanism.
[*] Added timed combat mechanism.
[*] Added shields.
[*] Created the tutorial (training) level. 
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/15bb7fc49c72b18a09b953630fdcf9b3ec96a437.png[/img]Added shields

[h3]What I'm working on right now[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Implementing level 1 cutscenes.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45309922/d35f6fc151c3c72a1519383d1a9bcef0eb5dce51.png[/img]This is where the level 1 (demo) intro scene will take place

[h3]What's left[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Finish cluttering the demo level castle.
[*] Receive and apply the rest of the voices.
[*] Polish and more polish.
[*] Test.
[*] Demo release!
[/olist]

[b]Cheers![/b]
